notes.title: Closed beta version update
notes.notes:
The archiving method has been modified so that the archive will not be lost in future updates.

Fixed the problem of heartbeat burst.

Added hidden eggs.

Fixed the problem that the selection diagram does not match the actual scene.

Fixed the problem of two week ghost call superposition.

It makes a complete distinction between the scene music of one week and two weeks.

It's even more scary.

The volume control and countdown icons were replaced, the volume control was changed to ears and wire, and the timer was changed to heart.

The heart in the lower right corner is hidden when the mouse passes by, which can avoid the problem of invisible hidden objects caused by picture overlap.

Click the heart position, and the heart will appear again. Pressing and holding will not affect the end of the acceleration time.

The scene cannot be returned immediately, which is a deliberate design. I want to wait for your feedback and change it if necessary.

The heartbeat of one week's eyes and two weeks' eyes are also different, and the two weeks' eyes are more rapid.

Countdown 10 seconds to add dynamic prompt.

Slightly increased the heartbeat time.

Turn the page turning arrow to the end of the page, and the page turning arrow disappears.
